sentences.sentence: At most companies, HR, IT, payroll and learning each run their own portal, with their own forms and owners.
sentences.heard: At most companies, HR, IT, payroll, and learning each run their own portal with their own forms and owners.

sentences.sentence: New hires have to work out which system, form and person applies, and support teams untangle requests that arrive incomplete or at the wrong desk.
sentences.heard: New hires have to work out which system, form and person applies, and support teams untangle requests that arrive incomplete or at the wrong desk.

sentences.sentence: Relay puts all of it in one workspace, with a Deepgram voice agent, Nova-3 listening and Flux speaking, that connects every service to a single conversation.
sentences.heard: Relay puts all of it in one workspace, with a deep-gram voice agent, NOVA 3 listening and flux speaking, that connects every service to a single conversation.

sentences.sentence: Here’s Maya, a new hire, on day one.
sentences.heard: Here's Maya, a new hire on day one.

sentences.sentence: It reads Maya’s own records, picks the task due first, and opens the exact form, ready to start.
sentences.heard: It reads Maya's own records, picks the task due first, and opens the exact form ready to start.

sentences.sentence: Raising a concern works the same way: Relay drafts a complete IT request for the right team and files it when Maya confirms.
sentences.heard: Raising a concern works the same way. Relay drafts a complete IT request for the right team and files it when Maya confirms.

sentences.sentence: It books meetings on the calendar and explains what’s holding up a first paycheck, and every action waits for the employee’s click.

sentences.sentence: Underneath, an intelligence layer built for Relay gives the agent a small set of tools to read records, open them, highlight sections and propose actions.

sentences.sentence: The agent only names the record; Relay works out the page and the highlight itself, and refuses any target it doesn’t recognize.

sentences.sentence: The server decides who is signed in and gives the agent that employee’s records alone, so each person reaches only what they’re authorized to see.

sentences.sentence: Sensitive details, like bank numbers, are removed before the agent ever sees them.

sentences.sentence: HR and IT see a timeline of every request, from what was asked to the verified change.

sentences.sentence: On the real app, 103 of 110 conversations ended fully right, and 31 of 34 spoken requests got a useful answer.

sentences.sentence: It stops talking within 51 milliseconds when the employee cuts in, and red-team attacks caused no unsafe actions.

sentences.sentence: That was Maya’s first day, sorted in a few sentences.
